children: Tidewater finalized the $500 million acquisition of Wilson Sons Ultratug Participações and Atlantic Offshore Services under an amended sale agreement, paying about $283.1 million in cash and assuming roughly $229.3 million of existing BNDES and Banco do Brasil debt. In parallel, the company became guarantor on a $22.5 million Banco do Brasil loan at 3.10% and arranged up to $170.5 million in unsecured bank guarantees with DNB Bank to support replacing BNDES parent guarantees by December 31, 2026. The moves enhance Tidewater’s Brazilian footprint while addressing key post-closing financing and guarantee requirements.
Agreement 1: Tidewater Completes $500 Million WSUT Acquisition; Assumes $229 Million Debt, Pays $283 Million Cash
: Amended and Restated Sale and Purchase Agreement
: Expand Brazilian offshore fleet and operations
Agreement 2: Tidewater Replaces Guarantor on $22.5 Million Banco do Brasil Loan at 3.10%
: Loan amendment and guaranty for Fixed Credit Facility No. 20/00502-4
Agreement 3: Tidewater Arranges Up to $170.5 Million DNB Bank Guarantees to Replace BNDES Parent Guarantees
: Facilitate release of sellers’ BNDES guarantees
